I got Kessel pure, glitterstim, and Felucian. What do you need?|Tetha Grig offers Obi-Wan Kenobi spice|audio=Grig-Spice.flac|}} '''Tetha Grig''' was a [[human]] [[Gender|female]] who worked as a [[spice dealer]] on her [[homeworld]], [[Daiyu]], after becoming separated from her family. In [[9 BBY]], she approached the [[Jedi]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and offered to sell him [[spice]], but Kenobi instead requested information. He claimed to have lost his [[Leia Skywalker Organa Solo|daughter]] and was hoping for a lead, but Grig instead told him that he would never find her and gave the Jedi a free portion of spice so that he could start forgetting about his lost [[Youngling|child]]. ==Biography== {{Quote|How about some information? I'm looking for my daughter. She was taken, and she's on this planet.''"
"''Well, if she's here you're never gonna see her again. Nobody leaves this place. I was someone's daughter once, too.|Obi-Wan Kenobi and Tetha Grig|audio=Kenobi-Grig-Information.flac|}} [[File:GrigDealing-Kenobi2.png|thumb|right|300px|Tetha Grig tried to sell spice to Obi-Wan Kenobi.]] Tetha Grig was a [[human]] [[Gender|female]] from the [[planet]] [[Daiyu]] who became separated from her family, ending up on the world's streets with many other [[Youngling|children]] in the same situtation. She became associated with [[slythmonger]]s and began selling addictive [[spice]] as a [[spice dealer]] to survive.''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia: The Comprehensive Guide to the Star Wars Galaxy]]'' During the [[Imperial Era|reign]] of the [[Galactic Empire]] in [[9 BBY]],{{KenobiDate|II}} she was working on a crowded [[Daiyu City|city]] street when she approached [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]], a [[Jedi]]-in-hiding who had come to the world to [[Search for Princess Leia|rescue]] the [[Ambush on Alderaan|kidnapped]] [[Princess]] [[Leia Skywalker Organa Solo|Leia Organa]]. Grig offered to sell Kenobi spice, but he instead asked for information, pretending that Organa was his [[Gender|daughter]]. Grig told Kenobi that if his daughter was on Daiyu then he would never find her. She then placed a container of [[Kessel pure]] spice from her satchel into the Jedi's pocket, explaining that it was free and that if he used a few more portions of spice, he would soon be able to forget about his daughter altogether. Grig then moved away from Kenobi back into the nearby crowds. ==Personality and traits== {{Quote|Here. That one's free. Couple more of those and you'll forget she ever existed.|Tetha Grig gives Obi-Wan Kenobi free spice|audio=Grig-Free.flac|}} [[File:GrigSpice-Kenobi2.png|thumb|left|300px|Tehta Grig gave Obi-Wan Kenobi Kessel pure spice to help him forget who she believed to be his missing daughter.]] Tetha Grig was young when she met Kenobi and considered him to be old. Pessimistic that any missing person on Daiyu could be found and believing that no one ever left the world, she advised that he give up rather than trying to help him find his "daughter," claiming that she had once been someone's daughter herself. She did, however, give him a free portion of spice to try and help him forget about his lost [[Youngling|child]], a decision she made based on empathy.{{Topps|set=2023 Topps Star Wars: Obi-Wan Kenobi|cardname=#21 - Obi-Wan Incognito|link=https://www.tcdb.com/ViewCard.cfm/sid/363350/cid/21461404/2023}} Grig had light skin, [[Color|green]] [[eye]]s, and pink [[hair]] that she wore in a shag cut.{{Kenobi|Part II}} {{AD|Disney+}} She had a series of ribbed protrusions running down both sides of her face. ==Equipment== Grig wore a black [[Clothing|shirt]] with a loose-knit pink cardigan over it and a [[necklace]]. She also wore a white [[scarf]] and yellow pants. Her [[ear]]s had multiple piercings, and she wore several rings on her fingers. She carried her spice in a satchel and had [[Kessel]] pure, [[glitterstim]], and [[Felucian (spice)|Felucian]] available when she met Kenobi. ==Behind the scenes== [[File:TethaGrigBehindTheScenes.png|thumb|right|280px|Ewan McGregor and Esther-Rose McGregor on the Daiyu set]] Tetha Grig appeared in the [[Part II|second episode]] of the ''[[Star Wars: Obi-Wan Kenobi]]'' television series, which aired on [[May 27]], [[2022]].{{Twitter|obiwankenobi|status/1530019678562549760|date=2022-05-27|''[[Star Wars: Obi-Wan Kenobi]]''|quote=The time for #ObiWanKenobi has arrived…early. Start streaming the first two episodes on @DisneyPlus TONIGHT at 9PM PT.|archivedate=20220527053945}} She was portrayed by [[Esther-Rose McGregor]], the daughter of [[Ewan McGregor]],{{WebCite|url=https://www.independent.co.uk/arts-entertainment/films/news/ewan-mcgregor-baby-name-mary-elizabeth-winstead-b1873811.html|text=Ewan McGregor's daughter reveals his partner Mary Elizabeth Winstead has given birth to baby boy|author=O'Connor, Roisin|date=2021-06-21|archivedate=20211118193027}} who portrayed Kenobi in the series. Grig's name was not spoken during the episode but is listed in the credits. ==Appearances== *{{Kenobi|Part II}} {{1st}} *[[Obi-Wan Kenobi 2|''Obi-Wan Kenobi'' 2]] ==Sources== *{{SWYouTube|ufI9DDBJVGs|Behind the Scenes of the Obi-Wan Kenobi Series!|sw_url=video/behind-the-scenes-of-the-obi-wan-kenobi-series}} *{{Topps|set=2023 Topps Star Wars: Obi-Wan Kenobi|cardname=#21 - Obi-Wan Incognito|link=https://www.tcdb.com/ViewCard.cfm/sid/363350/cid/21461404/2023}} *{{Topps|set=2023 Topps Star Wars|cardname=Tetha Grig|link=https://www.tcdb.com/ViewCard.cfm/sid/370777/cid/22170395}} *''[[The Ultimate Star Wars Quiz Book]]'' {{Imo}} *''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia: The Comprehensive Guide to the Star Wars Galaxy]]'' ==Notes and references== {{Mediacat|imagecat=Images of Tetha Grig|soundcat=Audio files of Tetha Grig}} {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |de=Tetha Grig |es=Tetha Grig |fr=Tetha Grig |ja=テサ・グリッグ |ka=ტეთა გრიგი |nl=Tetha Grig |pl=Tetha Grig }} {{DEFAULTSORT:Grig, Tetha}} [[Category:Females]] [[Category:Humans]] [[Category:Individuals with she/her pronouns]] [[Category:Spice dealers]]
